CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    product_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    product_name JSONB NOT NULL,
    brand JSONB,
    category JSONB,
    description JSONB,
    current_price NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL CHECK (current_price >= 0),
    cost_price NUMERIC(12, 4) CHECK (cost_price >= 0),
    currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL CHECK (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
    source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL',
    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id UUID,
    updated_by_user_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_source CHECK (source IN ('MANUAL', 'IMPORTED')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_products_creator FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, created_by_user_id) REFERENCES tenant_users(tenant_id, user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL (created_by_user_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_products_updater FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, updated_by_user_id) REFERENCES tenant_users(tenant_id, user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL (updated_by_user_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_tenant_product_perimeter UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id)
)

RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id UUID, role_key VARCHAR, business_name VARCHAR)

SET search_path = public
AS $$
    SELECT tu.tenant_id, tu.role_key, c.business_name
    FROM tenant_users tu
    JOIN companies c ON c.tenant_id = tu.tenant_id
    WHERE tu.user_id = p_user_id AND tu.removed_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY tu.joined_at ASC;
$$

CREATE FUNCTION public.can_read_domain_notification(event_name text) RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_users tu JOIN public.system_roles r ON r.role_key=tu.role_key
 WHERE tu.tenant_id=public.get_current_tenant() AND tu.user_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id',true),'')::uuid
 AND tu.removed_at IS NULL AND tu.platform_status='active'
 AND (r.permissions->>'all'='true' OR CASE
 WHEN event_name IN ('SUBSCRIPTION_CHANGED','CUSTOM_PLAN_OFFER_READY') THEN r.permissions->>'manage_billing'='true'
 WHEN event_name IN ('IMPORT_COMPLETED','IMPORT_FAILED') THEN r.permissions->>'manage_catalog'='true'
 WHEN event_name IN ('MARKET_ALERT_TRIGGERED','BUSINESS_RECOMMENDATION_READY') THEN r.permissions->>'view_analytics'='true' OR r.permissions->>'manage_catalog'='true'
 ELSE false END));
$$
